item.title: Katie’s Pizza & Pasta to open 4th location in Crestwood
item.description: Katie’s Pizza & Pasta Osteria is expanding again, opening its fourth location in Crestwood nearly 18 years after its first restaurant debuted in St. Louis.

item.title: Faith leaders rally for immigration reform on MLK Bridge
item.description: While police shut down the MLK Bridge downtown, demonstrators urged everyone to see immigrants as people, instead of policy.

item.title: Families grieving after murder-suicide in Jefferson County
item.description: A weekend meant to be about love and celebration ended in tragedy for a Jefferson County couple. Now, family members on both sides are left stunned and grieving after what investigators believe was a murder-suicide.

item.title: Fatal police chase ends in crash through business
item.description: A police chase ended in death after a driver crashed into a business in downtown Edwardsville.

item.title: Five bold predictions for the 2026 St. Louis Cardinals
item.description: As spring camp begins, it’s a good time to look ahead at what 2026 might have in store for the St. Louis Cardinals.

item.title: Missouri gas station gaming machines are illegal, judge rules
item.description: Thousands of video lottery terminals (VLTs) that operate in Missouri gas stations and closely resemble casino slot machines are illegal, a federal judge has ruled.

item.title: Fighting through pain; one investigator’s mission to serve
item.description: An on-duty crash nearly ended a law enforcement career eight years ago. Instead, while fighting through the pain, Lee Brousseau found a new way to serve.

item.title: Flu season surges in St. Louis, positivity rates jump to 37%
item.description: Doctors warn the spike is hitting families in waves, often starting with children before spreading to older relatives.

item.title: Robert Duvall’s deep ties to St. Louis area
item.description: Professor Chrissy Calkins Steele met Robert Duvall during his 2007 campus visit and smiled at the sight of a quote from the actor that hangs on the wall of the building where he once performed as a student.

item.title: St. Louis City SC to restrict Black Lives Matter flags, trans rights banner at home matches
item.description: St. Louis City SC recently notified fan groups that some displays previously used in supporter sections, specifically Black Lives Matter flags and a "Love Always Wins" transgender-rights banner, will be restricted during home matches this season.
